source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 3, 48. Καὶ τοσαῦτα παθὼν τῶν δεδρακότων ὑπεραλγεῖ, οὕτως "ἡ ἀγάπη τὸ κακὸν οὐ λογίζεται.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] And having suffered so many things he grieves beyond measure for those who have done them—thus “love does not reckon the evil.”
pass_b_english: And having suffered so many things he grieves beyond measure for those who have done them—thus “love does not reckon the evil.”

choices.why: Pauline echo at Lam 3:48 in Origen’s reading.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations disclosed in translator_notes.
